resources.string: Import game images you made from your own discs, from a PC or NAS on your home network

Share a folder in Windows (Properties > Sharing). For the host, enter this PC\'s IP address on your home network: run ipconfig in Command Prompt and use the IPv4 Address (for example 192.168.x.x). Sign in with a local Windows account that can access the folder; Microsoft accounts often cannot sign in to shared folders.
